_comment: Golden vectors for a label stroke depth_limit (front-surface lasso). Asserted by src/renderer/lib/frontSurface.test.ts (depthLimitPredicate, the live preview) and backend-api/tests/test_front_surface.py (_depth_limit_mask, what the session labels). Orthographic camera at z = 10 looking down -z over x, y in [-1, 1] on a 20 x 20 canvas, so view depth = 10 - z and pixel = ((x + 1) * 10, (1 - y) * 10). Thresholds are row-major float32 [3, inf, 5, 7]; outside the grid, or in an inf cell, a point passes.
